solverDefinition: Finds strongly connected components in a directed graph using two depth-first searches: one on the original graph and one on the reversed graph.
source: Swati Dhingra, Poorvi S. Dodwad, and Meghna Madan, "Finding Strongly Connected Components in a Social Network Graph," International Journal of Computer Applications, Volume 136, No. 7, February 2016. Section 4.4 describes Kosaraju's algorithm.
